critical_finding_during_step3.first_attempt: Build with only cuGraphLaunch + cuGraphLaunch_ptsz + cuGraphLaunchPipelined (driver-level) shims — cipher_rt_graph_launch_calls = 0 after inference
critical_finding_during_step3.root_cause: cudart-cudart's cudaGraphLaunch caches the real cuGraphLaunch pointer at libcudart load time, BEFORE our cuGetProcAddress hook can redirect. PyTorch's CUDAGraph.replay() calls cudaGraphLaunch (cudart-level) which uses the cached driver pointer — bypasses our driver-level shim entirely.
critical_finding_during_step3.fix: Added cudaGraphLaunch + cudaGraphLaunch_ptsz cudart-level shims. GOT-patches cudart's GOT entry so PyTorch's call routes through our shim, which then calls the real cudaGraphLaunch.
critical_finding_during_step3.second_attempt: cipher_rt_graph_launch_calls = 300 after 2 reps × 128 token inference — shim engaged
critical_finding_during_step3.lesson: Driver-level GOT patches alone are insufficient when cudart caches function pointers at init. Must intercept at the cudart-level too for the cudaGraph* family. Same pattern as cuLaunchKernel vs cudaLaunchKernel which may13 already had.
